instruction: Set the default font to Georgia in LibreOffice Writer.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed the default font to Times New Roman by navigating to Tools > Options > LibreOffice Writer > Basic Fonts (Western) and modifying the Default font field.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer Options dialog, find Basic Fonts settings, select fonts from dropdown, apply and confirm changes.
metadata.task_rationale: Same operation with a different target font (Georgia instead of Times New Roman) to verify the model can generalize the font change skill.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font to Georgia. Evaluator reuses the existing find_default_font metric which parses registrymodifications.xcu to verify the Standard font property.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly fetches registrymodifications.xcu which stores LibreOffice Writer default font settings.
Metric (find_default_font) correctly parses the XCU XML file, searching for the Standard property under /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont, and compares against the expected font name.
Expected value 'Georgia' matches the instruction requirement to set the default font to Georgia.
The metric correctly handles the rules parameter by directly accessing rules['font_name'], consistent with get_rule returning the rules dict.
No postconfig needed - the font setting persists in the registrymodifications.xcu file and does not depend on UI state.
Full instruction coverage - the single requirement (set default font to Georgia) is completely verified by this evaluator.
